def VTask.prev {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α :=
  if H : l.length = 1 then
    x
  else
    let prev_initial := l.getLast (by exact List.ne_nil_of_mem h)
    let rec helper (prev : α) (currents : List α) : α :=
      match currents with
      | [] => prev
      | h_cons :: t =>
        if h_cons == x then prev
        else helper h_cons t
    helper prev_initial l
